t: Some people believe a company should delay a product launch until every risk is understood. Others believe it is better to launch and correct as you go. Which do you agree with? Explain why, using specific reasons and examples.

I would say launch and correct, mainly for two reasons. First, no team ever understands every risk before shipping. You find the real ones in production, from real users, and waiting only means finding them later. Second, a long delay has its own cost, and nobody counts it. The team loses momentum and a competitor moves. So on balance, I would ship early with a plan to correct, rather than wait for a certainty that never arrives.
